content.title: How the original meaning of Mother's Day lives on today

Learn more Comments In this video Description How the original meaning of Mother's Day lives on today 14Likes6,905Views2024May 12 When people think about Mother's Day, they typically think about giving gifts to their mothers, especially cards or flowers. Mother's Day is more than just flowers or sitting down for a bite to eat. The special day devoted to mom has a historical reference beyond just gifts. The history of Mother's Day in United States goes back to 1914. When it was officially recognized as a holiday. Anna Jarvis created Mothers Day back in 1908 to promote both friendships and health for mothers across the country and have it spread nationally. Jarvis' persistence in wanting nationwide participation paid off when President Woodrow Wilson signed the measure and officially established the second Sunday in May as Mother's Day. And that original meaning seems to have lived on into the present day for some mothers. MORE: https://www.wtol.com/article/news/loc...
